summary: Bug fix: Constants.GCODE_MOVE/GCODE_MOVE_ALL now include the extended drill cycles (G74, G84, G88, G89) and Op/Base.py uses that constant when bracketing the path with coolant M8/M9, so a Tapping operation with CoolantMode set now emits coolant as the Drilling/Tapping pages already describe; no property, default, enumeration, panel control, or post-processor output changes beyond restoring documented behaviour.

meta.title: CAM: honor coolant for tapping cycles
